subject: Helio Audit: personnel lifecycle artifacts & sampling plan
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliofinancial.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: security@heliofinancial.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Request: personnel lifecycle evidence + sampling plan for upcoming audit

Hi Evelyn,

We are kicking off our 2026 vendor security review and need a compact package covering employee onboarding, background checks, mandatory security training, and offboarding controls for a sample of accounts. In particular, Helio needs the following items for a 20-person sample across roles (engineer, support, CS, product):

- Background check confirmations (redacted PII allowed) and vendor name/version (we use Checkr as a reference)
- Training completion records for security awareness + data handling (timestamps + course IDs)
- Okta audit/exemption logs showing deprovision timestamps for leavers
- Onboarding runbook or checklist for new hires (what steps are automated vs manual)
- A short narrative describing how we handle badge provisioning, laptop imaging, and access handoff at exit

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a packaged sample (redacted as needed) and a short sampling plan by Friday 2026-01-16? Also include any constraints (PII redaction, timing for exports).

Thanks in advance — if easier, we can hop on a 30-min call.

Best,
Samira
Security Program Manager
Helio Financial
[attachment: helio_subject_request.pdf (pdf)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliofinancial.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: personnel lifecycle evidence + sampling plan for upcoming audit

Samira — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the requested artifacts; below is our proposed approach and constraints.

Proposed sampling plan (summary):
- Sample size: 20 employees across engineering (8), customer success (5), product (4), support (3). Randomized selection from hires and leavers between 2024-07-01 and 2025-12-31.
- Deliverables: redacted background confirmations (vendor: Checkr), training completion export (course IDs + ISO timestamps), Okta deprovision log excerpts (CSV), onboarding runbook (PDF), short narrative (1 page).
- Redaction: We will redact SSNs, dates of birth, and candidate addresses. Background vendor will supply signed attestations where redaction prevents verification.
- Timeline: Draft package by 2026-01-15 for Helio internal review; final deliverable by 2026-01-22 if no major follow-ups.

Constraints and notes:
- Background reports are subject to vendor terms; we will provide redacted copies and an attestation from Checkr for identity/verification steps.
- Okta exports require a narrow query window to limit noise; David will include an excerpt and a summary of search parameters.
- Training logs include completion timestamps and anonymized user IDs; we can map IDs to role buckets in the separate index file.

I attached an inventory template (evid_inventory_helio_20260112.csv) to confirm what Helio needs. If the sample selection needs to focus on specific hires (e.g., high-privilege roles), say so and we will bias the draw.

Next steps: Stephanie will coordinate the exports and David will handle Okta and deprovision evidence. We’ll produce the draft zip with stubbed redactions and a short narrative.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: evid_inventory_helio_20260112.csv (csv)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: task splits for Helio evidence package

Eve / David — quick split of labor per Evelyn’s note: 

- Stephanie: training exports + mapping file; produce training_completions_redacted.pdf and training_id_map.csv by EOD 2026-01-14.
- David: Okta deprovision log + deprovision timeline summary; okta_deprovision_log_excerpt.txt and okta_deprovision_summary.md by 2026-01-14. Please include the exact query we ran (dates + org units).
- Evelyn: coordinate background attestations with Checkr and prepare 1-page narrative on onboarding/offboarding playbook; I’ll draft the runbook skeleton and drop a link to the internal runbook draft in Drive.

Note: we must be careful with PII redaction. Use the internal redaction checklist (linked in Drive). If Checkr refuses redaction, escalate to legal.

Assigning JIRA-SUP-928 for the evidence pull.

—Steph

[attachment: training_completions_request_spec.txt (txt)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliofinancial.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 15:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: personnel lifecycle evidence + sampling plan for upcoming audit

Hi Samira — quick update and delivery plan.

We’ve prepared a draft package and will make it available via a temporary Drive folder with limited access: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/EXAMPLE-helio-audit (link above).

Contents (draft):
- training_completions_redacted.pdf (redacted user details, course IDs + completion timestamps)
- evid_inventory_helio_20260112.csv (index mapping anonymized IDs to role buckets)
- okta_deprovision_log_excerpt.txt (CSV excerpt of deprovision events, includes account id, timestamp, admin action)
- onboarding_runbook_draft.pdf (internal runbook with automated steps highlighted)
- background_attestations_Checkr.pdf (attestation letters where vendor redaction removed PII)
- 1-page narrative (onboarding/offboarding controls and exception handling)

We’ve redacted DOBs and SSNs; per our vendor terms Checkr provided attestations rather than full unredacted reports. If Helio needs to see unredacted records under an LOA, please let us know legal contact and we’ll coordinate.

Estimated next steps: Helio review, flag any gaps, and we’ll respond to follow-ups within 3 business days.

If you want a synchronous walkthrough, I’m available 2026-01-16 09:00–12:00 PT.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
